title: Fix UPI payment option missing in desktop Razorpay checkout

requirements.text: Fix the Razorpay checkout configuration in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` so that the UPI payment method is included and visible in the desktop checkout flow. The device-aware payment method configuration currently used in the hook must be updated to ensure UPI is not excluded or omitted when the device is detected as desktop. UPI should appear as a payment option on both mobile and desktop.

quotes: In the desktop version the upi option is missing. Kindly fix it.
I'll fix the UPI payment option so it appears correctly in the desktop version of the Razorpay checkout.

acceptanceCriteria: The UPI payment option is visible in the Razorpay checkout modal when accessed from a desktop browser.
The UPI payment option continues to be visible in the Razorpay checkout modal when accessed from a mobile browser.
No other existing payment methods (cards, net banking, wallets, etc.) are removed from the desktop or mobile checkout configuration.
The fix is applied in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` within the device-aware payment method configuration logic.
The `isMobileDevice()` utility in `frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts` is not broken or changed in a way that affects other features.

constraints: Do not remove or disable any existing payment methods (cards, net banking, wallets) from either mobile or desktop configurations.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not change the backend schema or Motoko actor.
nonGoals: Adding new payment methods beyond fixing UPI visibility.
Redesigning the checkout UI or Razorpay modal styling.
Changes to the mobile checkout configuration unless required to fix the desktop UPI issue.
